result.instructions: Tools for SmartAccounts, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much does client Acme OU currently owe us?"; "Show the sales invoices we issued last month."; "Which vendor invoices from this quarter are still unpaid?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SmartAccounts data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smartaccounts_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smartaccounts_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smartaccounts_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. smartaccounts_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_clients
tools.title: List or search clients
tools.description: Customers of the company (purchasesales/clients:get): id, name, regCode, vatNumber, bank account, due days, discount, VAT code. Filter by name or registry code, by id, or by modification time. Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

name_or_reg_code.description: Name or registry code to search for.

modified_from.description: Only clients modified after, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

modified_to.description: Only clients modified until, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page_number from the previous reply (100 objects per page).

tools.name: smartaccounts_get_client_balance
tools.title: Get a client's outstanding balance
tools.description: The outstanding balance of one client (purchasesales/clients:getbalance), optionally on a past date and with the open documents. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

balance_date.description: Balance on this date, yyyy-mm-dd (default today).

fetch_details.description: Include the documents that make up the balance.

Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

name_or_reg_code.description: Name or registry code to search for.

modified_from.description: Only vendors modified after, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

modified_to.description: Only vendors modified until, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page_number from the previous reply (100 objects per page).

tools.name: smartaccounts_get_vendor_balance

tools.description: The outstanding balance owed to one vendor (purchasesales/vendors:getbalance), optionally on a past date and with the open documents. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

balance_date.description: Balance on this date, yyyy-mm-dd (default today).

fetch_details.description: Include the documents that make up the balance.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_articles
tools.title: List or search articles
tools.description: Products, services and warehouse items (purchasesales/articles:get): code, description, type, unit, VAT code, sales and purchase prices, accounts. Search by code or name, or by modification time. Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

search_string.description: Filter by article code or name.

modified_from.description: Only articles modified after, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

modified_to.description: Only articles modified before, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page_number from the previous reply (100 objects per page).

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_sales_invoices
tools.title: List sales invoices
tools.description: Sales (client) invoices (purchasesales/clientinvoices:get): number, client, dates, amounts, VAT, outstanding amount, optionally the rows. Filter by date, client, number or payment status (unpaid, overdue). Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

date_from.description: Invoices dated from, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

date_to.description: Invoices dated to, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

date_type.description: Which date the range filters: invoice date (default), entry date, due date or modification time.

payment_status.description: unpaid = not fully paid; overdue = unpaid and past due. Omit for all.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page_number from the previous reply (100 objects per page).

date_to.description: Invoices dated to, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

date_type.description: Which date the range filters: invoice date (default), entry date, due date or modification time.

payment_status.description: unpaid = not fully paid; overdue = unpaid and past due. Omit for all.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page_number from the previous reply (100 objects per page).

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: Bank and cash payments from clients and to vendors (purchasesales/payments:get): date, partner, account, currency, amount, optionally the rows (which invoices were paid). Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

date_from.description: Payments dated from, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

date_to.description: Payments dated to, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

partner_type.description: Only client payments or only vendor payments.

account_type.description: Only bank or only cash payments.

account_name.description: Filter by the bank or cash account name.

partner_id.description: Filter by client or vendor id.

partner_name.description: Filter by client or vendor name.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page_number from the previous reply (100 objects per page).

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_ledger_entries
tools.title: List general ledger entries
tools.description: General ledger entries of every type (general/entries:get): manual entries, invoices, payments, VAT returns, depreciation. Filter by date, type, text or payment status. Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

date_from.description: Entries dated from, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

date_to.description: Entries dated to, yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss, Estonian time).

date_type.description: Which date the range filters: entry date (default) or added/modified time.

doc_type.description: Only entries of this type (LEDGER_ENTRY = manual ledger entry).

filter_description.description: Filter by document number or row description.

payment_status.description: unpaid or overdue invoices only. Omit for all.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page_number from the previous reply (100 objects per page).

fetch_rows.description: Include the entry rows (account, debit, credit).

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_accounts

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_payment_methods

tools.name: smartaccounts_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Add a new client (purchasesales/clients:add). Search first with smartaccounts_list_clients so a client is not created twice. Returns clientId and the generated referenceNumber. This creates a real accounting record in the company's books. This server cannot edit or delete it; correct it in SmartAccounts. It never retries: if a reply is unclear, look in SmartAccounts before calling again. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

vat_pc.description: The client's default VAT code (the vatPc of smartaccounts_list_vat_rates), for example 20.

invoice_due_days.description: Default invoice due date in days.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, for example EE.

tools.name: smartaccounts_create_sales_invoice
tools.title: Create a sales invoice
tools.description: Post a new sales (client) invoice (purchasesales/clientinvoices:add). The invoice number is generated by SmartAccounts, totals and VAT are calculated from the rows, and the invoice is booked to the ledger at once (it is not a draft). The client must exist (smartaccounts_list_clients); each row's code must be an article code (smartaccounts_list_articles) and vat_pc a VAT code (smartaccounts_list_vat_rates). Fails if the period is locked. Returns invoiceId, number and the totals. This creates a real accounting record in the company's books. This server cannot edit or delete it; correct it in SmartAccounts. It never retries: if a reply is unclear, look in SmartAccounts before calling again. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

due_date.description: Due date, yyyy-mm-dd (default from the client's settings).

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate; only for a currency without an ECB rate.

invoice_note.description: Additional text printed on the invoice PDF.

reference_number.description: Reference number for payment orders (default generated).

price.description: Unit price, without VAT, with a full stop as decimal separator.

vat_pc.description: VAT code (the vatPc of smartaccounts_list_vat_rates), for example 20.

unit.description: Unit, for example pcs or h.

tools.name: smartaccounts_create_payment
tools.title: Create a payment
tools.description: Record a bank or cash payment against one or more invoices (purchasesales/payments:add): a client paying a sales invoice, or a payment to a vendor for a purchase invoice. Use smartaccounts_list_bank_accounts or _list_cash_accounts for account_name, and the invoice ids from the invoice lists. The currency must match the account's currency. Returns paymentId, number and amount. This creates a real accounting record in the company's books. This server cannot edit or delete it; correct it in SmartAccounts. It never retries: if a reply is unclear, look in SmartAccounts before calling again. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

partner_type.description: CLIENT = money received from a client; VENDOR = money paid to a vendor.

partner_id.description: The client id (partner_type CLIENT) or vendor id (VENDOR).

account_name.description: The name of the bank or cash account.

currency.description: Currency code, for example EUR; must match the account's currency.

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate; only for a currency without an ECB rate.

type.description: The kind of invoice this row pays.

amount.description: Amount paid against this invoice, in the payment currency.

tools.name: smartaccounts_create_ledger_entry
tools.title: Create a manual ledger entry
tools.description: Post a manual general ledger entry (journal entry, general/entries:add) in EUR. Debits must equal credits. Account codes come from smartaccounts_list_accounts. Fails if the period is locked. Returns id, number and amount. This creates a real accounting record in the company's books. This server cannot edit or delete it; correct it in SmartAccounts. It never retries: if a reply is unclear, look in SmartAccounts before calling again. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

rows.description: Entry rows; total debit must equal total credit.
